name: Southfury River
summary: Mount Hyjal's waters run south through central Kalimdor in the Southfury River. Along the way, the river divides Azshara from Ashenvale and Durotar from the Barrens, then reaches the Great Sea near Ratchet.

sections.title: A Vital Natural Divide
sections.body: The Southfury River starts high on Mount Hyjal and rushes through central Kalimdor. Its waters divide Ashenvale from Azshara, then Durotar from the Barrens. Only a few bridges cross its swift current. One guards Orgrimmar's rear gates, while another links Durotar to the Barrens. Near Ratchet, the river plunges over a waterfall into the Great Sea.

sections.title: Strategic Importance
sections.body: The Southfury gives the Horde a barrier and a route through the region. It shields Durotar's western approaches, including Orgrimmar, from immediate ground assault. Its waters also carry fresh mountain runoff through dry country. Just north of the western crossing into Orgrimmar, Ashenvale, Azshara, Durotar, and the Barrens meet. Holding the river keeps supply lines between Orgrimmar and outlying Horde settlements intact.

faq.q: Where does the Southfury River start and end?
faq.answer: The Southfury River begins high on Mount Hyjal and ends in a waterfall that pours into the Great Sea northeast of Ratchet. It flows south between Ashenvale, Azshara, Durotar, and the Barrens.

faq.q: Which zones does the river border?
faq.answer: The Southfury River divides Ashenvale from Azshara in the north, then the Barrens from Durotar in the south. North of Orgrimmar's western bridge, all four territories meet along the riverbanks.

faq.q: Where can travelers cross the Southfury River?
faq.answer: Travelers can cross the Southfury River by bridges linking Azshara to Ashenvale, reaching Orgrimmar's rear gates, and connecting Durotar with the Barrens.

faq.q: Why is the river important to Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: The Southfury River shields the western flank of Orgrimmar and Durotar. It also carries fresh mountain water through a dry region.

angles.text: For the Horde, the Southfury River guards Durotar's western edge and links the capital to the heart of the Barrens.
